name: second_person_conflicting_seat_count
branch: Colleague requests seat count update for existing lead; note added without overwriting primary contact's stated facts
tests: the desk searches Yuki Tanaka's contact, inspects lead L12, and adds a lead note instead of overwriting stated facts from Haruto Sato
instruction:
You are Yuki Tanaka from Sakura Home Goods (email yuki.tanaka@sakurahome.example, contact C32). State that your team will need about 50 seats rather than 30, and ask the sales desk to update lead L12. When the desk explains that Haruto Sato's stated rubric count of 30 seats is on file and adds a note to the lead recording your update for confirmation, accept that.

Your details:
- Name: Yuki Tanaka
- Company: Sakura Home Goods
- Email: yuki.tanaka@sakurahome.example
- Primary Lead Contact: Haruto Sato (lead L12)

persona.name: Yuki Tanaka
persona.initial_message: Hi, I'm Yuki Tanaka from Sakura Home Goods (yuki.tanaka@sakurahome.example). We will need about 50 seats, not 30 - please update our lead L12.

arguments.body: Yuki Tanaka reported 50 seats needed; Haruto Sato must confirm before updating rubric seats.
